capabilities: expand the selection outward one syntactic unit per keypress
shrink the selection back through the expansion history
select table cells, rows and whole tables incrementally
expand within fenced code blocks and math blocks
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Keybindings must be assigned by the user; the README documents them as defaults.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to progressively expand or shrink the text selection through syntactic units, so users must drag selections manually.
summary: Selection expander that grows the selection outward through word, sentence, paragraph, section and document, like VSCode's Expand Selection.
